# TourRadar

> > TourRadar is a global multi-day tour marketplace connecting travelers with tour operators across adventure travel, cultural tours, wildlife expeditions, and specialty trips worldwide.

TourRadar aggregates thousands of tours from operators like Exodus Adventure Travels, TruTravels, INTRO Travel, and Oasis Overland, offering destinations from Egypt's Nile Valley to Peru's Andes Mountains, Iceland's glaciers, and India's Golden Triangle. The platform features operator reviews, last-minute deals, sustainable travel resources, and travel agent training programs.

## Key Topics

- Multi-day tours
- Tour operator marketplace
- Adventure travel
- Egypt tours (Cairo, Giza, Luxor, Nile Valley)
- India tours (Golden Triangle)
- Youth travel
- Cultural tours
- Wildlife tours
- Africa tours
- Peru & Andes Mountains
- Iceland & Reykjavik
- Customer reviews & ratings
- Sustainable travel
- Travel agent programs
- Last-minute tour deals
